nodes.name: Artificial intelligence
nodes.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the intelligence of machines or software, as opposed to the intelligence of living beings, primarily of humans. It is a field of research in computer science that develops and studies methods and software which enable machines to perceive their environment and use learning and intelligence to take actions that maximize chances of achieving defined goals.

nodes.name: Applications of AI
nodes.description: Some high-profile applications of AI include advanced web search engines, recommendation systems, interacting via human speech, autonomous vehicles, generative and creative tools, and superhuman play and analysis in strategy games.

nodes.description: Large language models (LLMs) are a type of AI trained on enormous amounts of text data.

nodes.description: Transformer architectures with self-attention mechanisms are used by large language models to learn relationships between tokens in text.

nodes.name: Fine-tuning
nodes.description: Fine-tuning is a process used to align model behavior with human preferences in large language models.

nodes.description: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is used to align large language models' behavior with human preferences.

nodes.name: Natural language processing
nodes.description: In natural language processing, AI models can perform question answering, summarization, translation, and creative writing at near-human levels.

nodes.name: Computer vision
nodes.description: In computer vision, deep learning models achieve superhuman accuracy on image classification benchmarks.

nodes.name: Multimodal models
nodes.description: Multimodal models process both text and images and are becoming increasingly powerful in AI.

nodes.name: AI safety and alignment research
nodes.description: AI safety and alignment research focuses on ensuring that AI systems behave as intended and do not cause unintended harm.

nodes.name: Economic and social impacts of AI
nodes.description: AI may displace certain jobs while creating new categories of work and accelerate scientific discovery in various domains. Policymakers are developing regulations to govern AI deployment.
